profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at symplr
profile.summary:
A motivated and innovative software developer who draws on 19+ years of experience, educational background, Microsoft certifications and Scrum certifications to architect enterprise-grade applications, improve software development processes, mentor team members and solve complex problems with creative solutions.

My primary technical skill set revolves around the Microsoft .NET development stack and related Microsoft Server products (SQL Server and IIS). I graduated from UW-Milwaukee with my MBA in May 2008, and BBA in May 2005. I also am a Microsoft Certified Solution Developer (MCSD: Web Applications) and a certified Professional Scrum Developer and Scrum Master.

Specialties: Microsoft .NET Technologies, Microsoft MVC, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, jQuery; Scrum.org framework.

positions.title: Solutions Consultant
positions.description: I am a Solutions Consultant at Omni Resources. In my time at Omni, so far, I’ve worked on 4 different projects for 3 different clients; ranging from discovery and SOW development for a local real estate development firm, to developing significant enhancements to an existing PHP application for a local credit union marketing firm, to developing an API architecture using Microsoft WebAPI for a Wisconsin based Jewelry Insurance company, to developing a JavaScript widget for ecommerce partners of the insurance client to host on their website to provide instant insurance quotes.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Consulting at Southern Star through Centare to provide technical and Scrum leadership to their CSI team. Will be working on their CSI application which is an external facing web application that customers use to request gas transportation on Southern Star's pipeline.
